mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_ID as memberId, m.NAME as name, m.EMAIL as email, m.PHONE as phone, l.LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, l.LICENSE_NO as licenseNo, l.SPECIALTY as specialty, l.INTRO as intro, l.OFFICE_NAME as officeName, l.CONSULT_FEE as consultFee, (SELECT NVL(AVG(RATING), 0) FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') as avgRating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') as reviewCnt, a.ATTACH_ID as attachId, a.SAVE_PATH as savePath, a.ORIG_NAME as origName FROM TB_MEMBER m INNER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT a ON l.LAWYER_ID = a.REF_ID AND a.REF_TYPE = 'LAWYER' WHERE l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND m.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY avgRating DESC, reviewCnt DESC

SELECT m.MEMBER_ID as memberId, m.NAME as name, m.EMAIL as email, m.PHONE as phone, l.LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, l.LICENSE_NO as licenseNo, l.SPECIALTY as specialty, l.INTRO as intro, l.CAREER as career, l.OFFICE_NAME as officeName, l.OFFICE_ADDR as officeAddr, l.CONSULT_FEE as consultFee, (SELECT NVL(AVG(RATING), 0) FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') as avgRating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') as reviewCnt, a.SAVE_PATH as savePath, r.REVIEW_ID, r.RATING, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT as REVIEW_CREATED_AT, SUBSTR(rm.NAME, 1, 1) || '*' || SUBSTR(rm.NAME, 3) as REVIEWER_NAME, SUBSTR(c.NOTE, 1, 5) || '***' as CONSULT_SUMMARY FROM TB_MEMBER m INNER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT a ON l.LAWYER_ID = a.REF_ID AND a.REF_TYPE = 'LAWYER' LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_REVIEW r ON l.LAWYER_ID = r.LAWYER_ID AND r.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MEMBER rm ON r.MEMBER_ID = rm.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CONSULT c ON r.CONSULT_ID = c.CONSULT_ID WHERE l.LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT m.NAME, m.LOGIN_ID, l.LAWYER_ID, l.MEMBER_ID, l.LICENSE_NO, l.SPECIALTY, l.OFFICE_NAME, TO_CHAR(l.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, a.SAVE_PATH FROM TB_MEMBER m JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT a ON l.LAWYER_ID = a.REF_ID AND a.REF_TYPE = 'LAWYER' WHERE l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LAWYER SET APPROVE_STATUS = #{approveStatus}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId}
